$comment: The specifications the mocks are checked against. Each one is fetched from the provider's own repository, so the mocks stay in step with the real API. A specification with `check: true` is also compared with the routes the mock serves — a route the provider does not have is a route that has drifted, and it fails the build.

twilio.note: Twilio API v2010 — the SMS routes

stripe.note: Stripe's OpenAPI description. It is kept out of the repository — it is large, and it is checked, not shipped.
